## User Services
User Services links members to the specific services they offer on the directory. Each record associates a member with a service category and optionally captures pricing, completion count, and specialty status for that service.

## The User Services Object
Field Type Description rel_id integer Unique service relationship record ID (primary key, read-only) user_id integer ID of the member offering this service (foreign key to users ) service_id integer ID of the service being offered (foreign key to the services reference table) date string Date this service relationship was created, formatted as YYYYMMDDHHmmss avg_price number Average price the member charges for this service (decimal with 2 decimal places) num_completed string Number of times the member has completed this service specialty integer Whether this is a specialty service for the member ( 0 = no, 1 = yes)

## List User Service Records
Returns a paginated list of user service records.
